name: BETHANY
confidence: high for the notes; check the underlay of bars 7 and 15
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (Lowell Mason's setting, 1859).
reviewNotes: High for the notes and rhythm, which match the tune as sung. Check bars 7 and 15: 'that' (and the last 'near-') is sung over soh-doh before 'rais-eth' / '-er to', as this source prints it. British books often use Dykes's HORBURY for these words instead.
